reference_input.description: Path to a reference input (JSON, fasta, excel, or Genbank files). NOTE: a single fasta, excel, JSON is required. For Genbank files, multiple can be specified, but the command needs ' ' to prevent shell script issues.

technology.description: Technology to guide workflow. Guides QC and alignment.

adapter_fasta.description: FASTA file containing adapter sequences for trimming.

fastp_extra_args.description: Extra args for fastp or fastplong.

primer_file.description: Path to a primer file for primer removal via either primer masking or iVar trimming. File should not have headers and include 6 columns: reference, start, end, name, integer, strand (+/-) (SEE: https://andersen-lab.github.io/ivar/html/manualpage.html). NOTE1: The +/- strand direction is critical and based on the reference (i.e.m + notations must be on left, - must be on the right). NOTE2: PRIMER MASKING will mask Forward and Reverse primers if they are within the wiggle and on appropriate side of the amplicon.

mask_primers.description: Mask primers using the custom ASAP masking script. Default true if bed file is specified unless 'false' specified.

wiggle.description: FOR PRIMER MASKING ONLY: Wiggle distance for primer masking.

mask_bam.description: FOR PRIMER MASKING ONLY: Whether to mask primers in the BAM file.

primer_only.description: FOR PRIMER MASKING ONLY: Only perform primer masking.

ref_names.description: Name(s) of the reference contig(s) for which identity is calculated; if omitted, apply to all contigs.

variant_calling_options.title: Shared Variant Calling and Consensus Options

proportion.description: Minimum proportion required to call a variant/iSNV at a given locus (iVar variant -t argument).

consensus_proportion.description: Minimum proportion required to call a base at that position, else 'N' (iVar consensus -c argument).

depth.description: Minimum read depth required to consider a position covered (iVar consensus -m argument).

min_base_qual.description: Minimum base quality score to use a position for variant/iSNV or consensus calling (phred scale, i.e. 10=90, 20=99, 30=99.9 accuracy) (iVar variant and consensus -q argument).

bam_processor_options.title: bam_processor Specific Options and JSON generation

asap_snps.description: Disable ASAP SNP and Consensus profiling (i.e., bam_processor)...

breadth.description: Minimum breadth of coverage required to consider an amplicon as present

mutation_depth.description: Minimum number of reads required to call a mutation at a given locus.

fill_character.description: Character to use for filling gaps.

fill_gaps.description: Whether to fill gaps in BAM processing.

mark_deletions.description: Whether to mark deletions in BAM processing.

whole_genome.description: JSON file uses a whole genome reference, so don't write out the consensus, depth, and proportion arrays for each sample

out_file.description: Name of the output HTML file.

asaptools_options.title: Specific Options for ASAP Tools Processing

asaptools_processing.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools R-script downstream processing.

asaptools_cov_table.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools Coverage Table.

asaptools_qc_plots.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools QC Plots.

asaptools_snp_table.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools SNP Table.

asaptools_fasta.description: Enable/Disable the ASAP Tools fasta generation.

asaptools_positions_of_interest.description: Path to CSV file containing genes/positions of interest. This is helpful if processing amplicon data using WGS reference.

asaptools_min_location_depth.description: Minimum depth required at a specific location to consider SNPs or Coverage in Table.

asaptools_snp_proportion.description: SNP Table Parameter: Minimum proportion required to call a variant in the ASAP Tools script.

asaptools_genbank_location.description: SNP Table Parameter: Path to the reference GenBank file.

asaptools_max_sample_snp_count.description: SNP Table Parameter: Maximum number of SNPs allowed per sample. This filters samples with >x snps in the SNP table.

asaptools_samples_to_remove.description: SNP Table Parameter: Comma-separated list of Sample IDs to exclude from the SNP table.

asaptools_breadth_threshold.description: Breadth of coverage min (>) to export fasta files for.

ivar.description: Execute full iVar workflow (trim, variants, consensus). Warning: incompatible with --smor.

ivar_trim.description: Flag to execute ivar trim ONLY. Not recommended.

ivar_variants.description: Flag to execute ivar variants ONLY. Useful for comparing ASAP SNPs to iVar.

ivar_consensus.description: Flag to execute ivar consensus ONLY.

bwa_container.description: Container image for bwa and samtools.

bowtie2_container.description: Container image for bowtie2 and samtools.
